title: Discount tier boundary is exclusive, so orders exactly at a threshold get no discount
instruction: test_pricing.py::test_discount_tier_boundary_is_inclusive is failing. An order whose subtotal equals a discount tier's threshold should receive that tier's discount, but it gets nothing. Find and fix the bug in the ledger package. Do not change the tests. Run tests/test_pricing.py to confirm.

ground_truth.why_multi_file: Local boundary bug; the docstring on rate_for states tiers are inclusive ('meets or exceeds'), so reading the function is enough.
